item.text: The spatial goals reduce to finite store collections, with reassociation, permutation, and empty-heap units needed to connect them. I’ll use pointwise witness transformations; the reversed undefined stores need explicit commutation.

arguments.code:
var helpers = `(* Pointwise transformations retain the concrete separating witnesses. *)
Lemma finite_trans (P Q R : model -> Prop) :
  (P |-- Q) -> (Q |-- R) -> (P |-- R).
Proof. intros HP HQ h Hh. apply HQ, HP, Hh. Qed.

Lemma finite_frame (P Q R S : model -> Prop) :
  (P |-- R) -> (Q |-- S) -> (P ** Q |-- R ** S).
Proof.
  intros HP HQ h Hh.
  destruct Hh as [a [b [HJ [HA HB]]]].
  exists a, b. split; [exact HJ | split; [apply HP | apply HQ]; assumption].
Qed.

Lemma finite_assoc (P Q R : model -> Prop) :
  (P ** Q) ** R |-- P ** (Q ** R).
Proof.
  intros h [ab [c [HJ [[a [b [HAB [HA HB]]]] HC]]]].
  destruct (join_assoc _ _ _ _ _ HAB HJ) as [bc [HBC HABC]].
  exists a, bc. split; [exact HABC | split; [exact HA |]].
  exists b, c. split; [exact HBC | split; assumption].
Qed.

Lemma finite_rotate (P Q A R : model -> Prop) :
  (Q |-- A ** R) -> (P ** Q |-- A ** (P ** R)).
Proof.
  intros HQ h [p [q [HPQ [HP Hq]]]].
  destruct (HQ _ Hq) as [a [r [HAR [HA HR]]]].
  pose proof (join_comm _ _ _ HPQ) as HQP.
  destruct (join_assoc _ _ _ _ _ HAR HQP) as [rp [HRP HARP]].
  exists a, rp. split; [exact HARP | split; [exact HA |]].
  exists p, r. split; [apply join_comm; exact HRP | split; assumption].
Qed.

Lemma finite_unit (P : model -> Prop) : P |-- P ** emp.
Proof.
  intros h HP. destruct (unit_join h) as [u [HU HJ]].
  exists h, u. split; [exact HJ | split; assumption].
Qed.

Ltac finite_pick :=
  first [apply finite_unit |
    apply finite_frame; [intros ? ?; assumption | intros ? ?; assumption] |
    eapply finite_rotate; finite_pick].

Ltac finite_heap :=
  first [solve [intros ? ?; assumption] |
    match goal with
    | |- ((?P ** ?Q) ** ?R |-- ?S) =>
        eapply finite_trans; [apply finite_assoc | finite_heap]
    end |
    match goal with
    | |- (?P ** ?Q |-- ?R) =>
        eapply finite_trans;
        [apply finite_frame; [intros ? ?; assumption | apply finite_assoc] | finite_heap]
    end |
    match goal with
    | |- (?P |-- ?A ** ?B) =>
        eapply finite_trans; [finite_pick |];
        apply finite_frame; [intros ? ?; assumption | finite_heap]
    end |
    solve [intros ? ?; repeat split; try assumption; reflexivity]].

Ltac finite_array :=
  cbn [CharArray.seg CharArray.full store_array store_array_rec
       repeat_Z StoreCharAsElement.storeA];
  rewrite ?sizeof_char;
  cbn;
  finite_heap.

`;
candidate = candidate.replace('Theorem resolved_',helpers+'Theorem resolved_');
candidate = candidate.replace(/Theorem (resolved_(init_array2_[^ ]+)) : ([^.]+\.[^.]+)\.\nProof\. Admitted\./g, function(all,name,goal,target){
 var proof;
 if (/entail_wit_([1-8])_split_goal_spatial$/.test(goal)) proof='unfold ExecutionGoal.'+goal+'. finite_array.';
 else if (/entail_wit_([1-8])$/.test(goal)) {var i=goal.match(/wit_(\d+)/)[1];proof='unfold ExecutionGoal.'+goal+'. right. exact resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_'+i+'_split_goal_spatial.';}
 else if (goal==='init_array2_entail_wit_9_split_goal_1') proof='unfold ExecutionGoal.'+goal+'. intros ? ?. change (repeat_Z 0 0 = (@nil Z)). reflexivity.';
 else if (goal==='init_array2_entail_wit_9_split_goal_spatial') proof='unfold ExecutionGoal.'+goal+'. cbn [CharArray.undef_full store_undef_array store_undef_array_rec StoreCharAsElement.undefstoreA]. rewrite ?sizeof_char. cbn. finite_heap.';
 else if(goal==='init_array2_entail_wit_9') proof='unfold ExecutionGoal.'+goal+'. right. intros h Hh. split. - exact (resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_9_split_goal_1 h Hh). - exact (resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_9_split_goal_spatial h Hh).';
 else proof='unfold ExecutionGoal.'+goal+'. left. intros. subst. exists (repeat_Z 0 8). finite_array.';
 return 'Theorem '+name+' : '+target+'.\nProof. '+proof+' Qed.';
});
console.log(candidate.includes('Admitted')); await fs.writeFile('Candidate.v',candidate);
